ValidationRule.description: When the Record Type is Partner Transition ISR (API Name: Direct_To_Indirect_Partner_Transition_ISR) and the Transition Type = Direct to Indirect, THEN Partner Name is required
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_To_Indirect_Partner_Transition_ISR', ISPICKVAL(Transition_Type__c, "Direct-to-Indirect"), OR( ISBLANK( Partner_Name_lookup__c), ISBLANK( Proposed_Partner_Margins__c), ISBLANK( Partner_Value_in_Opportunity__c ), ISBLANK( Additional_comments_from_Partner__c )), NOT( $Permission.DisableValidationRules))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Partner Fields in the Partner Details section are all required when Transition Type is Direct To Indirect.
